parts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated reference for one modular realistic medieval RPG upper-body armor, for image-to-3D reconstruction. Make a practical starter knight steel plate cuirass with integrated rounded pauldrons, articulated upper-arm and forearm armor, small elbow cops, overlapping waist lames ending at the hips. Matching set design: satin silver forged steel, subtle rolled steel edges, restrained dark steel rivets, charcoal padded fabric only at flexible joints, a few dark brown fastening straps; no gold, no ornament, no heraldry. Athletic adult male proportions, regular build, not bulky. Hollow empty garment in a symmetrical neutral T-pose, both arms extended perfectly horizontal, wrists open and empty, neck open, no hands, no head, no person, no mannequin, no legs. Direct front view, near orthographic, full object centered and filling image with generous margin around arm ends. Uniform pale gray background, clean softly lit game asset render with readable separate plates, physically plausible steel highlights, no cast shadow, no text, no panels, no weapons, no additional objects. The garment must have sleeves and both arms from shoulders through forearms, but no gloves.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated modular medieval RPG armor reference for image-to-3D reconstruction. Design matches the reference upper-body armor exactly in material language: satin silver forged steel, subtle rolled edges, small dark steel rivets, charcoal quilted fabric at flexible joints, dark brown fastening straps, no gold, no heraldry, no ornament. The input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, do not include the cuirass or arms in the output. Clean softly lit realistic game asset render, uniform pale gray backdrop, one single view, no people, mannequin, human skin, labels, text, panels or extra objects. Primary request: one hollow pair of armored trousers for an athletic adult male, waist through ankles, front view near orthographic. Complete connected trousers with a narrow charcoal waistband and flexible charcoal crotch, silver steel articulated cuisses covering thighs, rounded knee cops, narrow articulated calf plates. Legs straight and slightly separated at the ankles, left-right symmetric, natural proportions. No feet, boots, torso or belt ornaments. Centered, whole garment visible, 10% empty margin. Functional starter knight design with clearly readable metal thigh and knee plates, not fabric trousers.

processing.method: Fit to original 65-bone A pose, adjust gorget and wrist openings, align knees/ankles, fit five finger landmarks and mirror gauntlet; transfer body weights, rigid Head binding for helmet. Smooth normals, rebuild tangent space, compact GLB data, compress runtime textures. No geometry decimation after generation.
processing.licenses: Inherited from original modular body/Mixamo and the Meshy paid-generation terms recorded above; local fitting adds no third-party asset.

ankle_correction.method: Recenter boot cuffs on each shin bone axis; taper greave ends inside the cuffs; use the same height-based Leg/Foot blend over both ankle overlaps. Preserve toes, soles and triangle counts.
ankle_correction.visual_review: Both ankles from front and rear: idle, combat idle, two walking phases, running and jumping.

wrist_correction.method: Center and taper distal vambraces on each ForeArm–Hand axis. Align and flare gauntlet cuffs around that axis, blending back into the existing palm warp. Use the same axial-distance ForeArm/Hand weight profile throughout the overlap.

wrist_cuff_rebuild.method: Remove three nonmanifold source flaps per hand, clip the old cuff at source Z = -0.5, stitch its ordered boundary to an elliptical steel cuff with a beveled rim, and close the inside with a recessed padded lining. Mirror the completed geometry and retain the shared ForeArm/Hand weights. Store part metadata on the mesh as well as its node for multi-material loading.

visual_review.views: Side views and oblique views looking into both cuff openings
